note: The Create probe's cases (help-create-probe.cli.ts). `world` is a bundled world's file name in src/defaultworlds, open in the World Editor. `blocks` is how many entity blocks the ask wants. A redraft carries the last exchange in `earlier` and `earlierAnswer`. A refusal case asks from a screen with no World Editor (`surface`) and wants no block; every other case asks from the World Editor's Entities tab. `set`: `dev` cases may steer a prompt revision; `blind` cases were written with the dev set, before any run, and no revision is tuned on them. Kinds: single, several, redraft, refusal.
